scope: Typed device ports, chain validation, identity, persistence and compilation into prepared render plans
environment: Kvant, pinned CI image, docker --network none
verified_behaviors: A MIDI-track chain (transpose +5, transpose -12, gain -6 dB) validates in the declared order source -> 1 -> 3 -> instrument -> 2 -> output
Compiled notes are 7 semitones lower at the same starts; device_gain equals 10^(-6/20) for that track and 1 elsewhere
A note leaving 0-127 at the first of two transposes is dropped even though the second would bring it back
devices-v1 round trips exactly; unknown kind, extra field, unknown endpoint, a three-endpoint connection, devices without the feature and a counter at an existing ID are refused

Refused graphs with their messages: MIDI source into an audio port, a branch, a loop beside the chain (cycle), a loose device, an unknown device, a connection out of the output, MIDI into the output; also non-integer or out-of-range transpose, out-of-range or NaN gain, nine devices, +36 dB combined gain, a MIDI device on an audio track, an unknown track and two chains for one track
DocumentRenderPlan refuses device_gain 17; the engine multiplies device_gain with a level lane (0.5*0.25 then 0.5*0.5*0.25)

Session: duplicate copies a chain under fresh IDs 3 and 4 with remapped connections and counter 5; delete removes the chain; Undo restores it; loading a cyclic or mistyped chain is refused with the open document, path and history unchanged
limits: No device UI, parameter automation or live device edits yet (#77); compilation is static per prepared plan.
